steps.message: The 60-item limit came from the Northwind contract, which ended on 2025-10-31. Config and design doc already say 100, so ADR 0007 is the stale one. I'll record a superseding decision.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0008: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60 because Northwind Logistics accepted at most 60 lines per order (contract section 4). That contract ended on 2025-10-31 and was not renewed; since 2025-11-01 we fulfil from our own warehouse, which has no limit on lines per order (docs/ops/fulfilment.md).

In 2026-08, 40 customers reported being unable to add more than 60 items; requested sizes had a median of 80 and a maximum of 100 (docs/support/2026-08-cart-limit-inquiries.md). Commit 26d74db raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md but left ADR 0007 unchanged, causing the inconsistency in issue #12.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. config/cart.yaml (`max_items.default: 100`) and docs/design/cart.md already reflect this.

## Consequences
- The original reason for 60 no longer applies.
- 100 covers the largest requested cart size; raise it again only with new evidence.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md (2026-11-01)/' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
git add -A && git commit -qm "docs: record cart limit decision 0008, supersede ADR 0007

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1

steps.message:
The cart limit is now consistently 100, and the decision is recorded. I committed it locally as `aab5694`. I haven't pushed it or commented on issue #12.

- **Cause:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100 after commit 26d74db. ADR 0007 still said 60.
- **Why 100 and not 60:** the 60 came from the Northwind Logistics contract, which ended 2025-10-31. Our own warehouse, used since 2025-11-01, has no line limit. In August 2026, 40 customers asked for larger carts, up to 100.
- **New record:** `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md` sets out the context and the 100-item decision.
- **ADR 0007:** its status line now reads "Superseded by" the new decision. I left the rest of it as it was.

The repo already has `docs/adr/`, but you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so the new record lives there. If you'd rather keep a single directory, the new file can move into `docs/adr/`.
